identity.one_line: The commerce platform that thinks with you. Powered by Easy Pay Direct.
identity.positioning: Agentic inside and out. Inside, AI is built in where it helps most. Outside, a hosted MCP server and open-source Agent Skills let Claude, Cursor, and other AI agents work with your catalog directly.
identity.voice: Confident, plainspoken, grounded. Short declarative sentences. Talk to "you" and "your business." Never hype, never hedging, never exclamation points.

naming_rules.never_confuse: EPD Commerce and Easy Pay Direct are separate brands. Never use "EPD" as a standalone shorthand for Easy Pay Direct.
naming_rules.pillar_capitalization: Create, Analyze, React, Transact are always capitalized.
naming_rules.agentic_commerce: "agentic commerce" is lowercase in running text. Only capitalize if it starts a sentence.

horizontal_primary.role: Default lockup. Use everywhere unless space forces the stacked version.

stacked_secondary.role: For square or vertical spaces. App icons, avatars, merch, social profile.

hero_diamonds.role: Decorative background motif. Cascading diamond outlines. Used on cover pages, section dividers, hero backgrounds. Reduce opacity to 40-60% when placing over content.

color.pillar_accent_rules: Pillar accents are used only for pill labels, eyebrows, and thin accents. Never as large surface fills.
color.green_rule: Green is semantic only. It appears inside the product to signal positive movement or success states. Never on marketing pages, ads, emails, or any brand surface as a general accent.

typography.usage: General Sans for headings and body. DM Mono for eyebrows, technical labels, and metadata.
typography.case: Sentence case in headlines. Never Title Case.

taglines.primary: Most AI helps you write faster. EPD Commerce helps you run better.
variants: The commerce platform that thinks with you.
One platform. Four things it does well.
contrast_framing: Most AI helps you write faster. EPD Commerce helps you run better.
Most platforms tell you a payment failed. EPD Commerce does something about it.

do: Open features with a second-person imperative sentence fragment: "Your revenue command center."
Title product features as proper nouns with periods: "Revenue Recovery." "Order Rescue."
Ground claims in specifics: 100k+ businesses, $12B+ processed, 5 recovery templates, 15 notification triggers.
Use commas, periods, or parentheses for pauses.
Spell the pillars exactly: Create, Analyze, React, Transact.
Use "agentic commerce" lowercase in running text.
Say what AI actually does: analyzes transactions, recovers failed payments.
Attribute agentic behavior to features. "Order Rescue reaches customers." Not "AI reaches customers."
dont: Title Case Headlines That Feel Corporate.
Open with abstract nouns: "A tool to manage revenue." "Solutions for your catalog."
Lowercase feature names in body copy, or hedge them with generic words like "our recovery system."
Use hype words: revolutionary, game-changing, supercharge.
Use em dashes. They are off brand.
Rename pillars or add new ones.
Say "AI runs the mechanics of your business." Do not overclaim.
Attribute product actions to "AI" as if it is a person. Name the feature.
